run_bm_vert_align: run the bm_vert_align benchmark function to measure vertex alignment performance across mesh sizes and devices
benchmark_vert_align: benchmark vertex alignment using TestVertAlign.vert_align_with_init across multiple mesh configurations on cpu and cuda
test_vert_align_performance: test vertex alignment performance with varying num_meshes, num_verts, and num_faces parameters
run_benchmark_cli: run the bm_vert_align module directly via python to execute vertex alignment benchmarks
refactor_bm_vert_align: refactor bm_vert_align to add new mesh size combinations or device targets for benchmarking
